name: Mole-Stache
bodyType: Small mole-like humanoid with a giant mustache
abilities: Comakinesis - a free-forming prehensile mustache that stretches and reshapes into hands, wraps, maces and weapons
Mustache flight - twirls the mustache like helicopter rotors; also works as a parachute or catches drafts
Mustache strength - lifted a truck (Breakpoint) and a tree (A New Dawn)
Mustache regeneration if cut or shaved
Skilled mustache-based hand-to-hand combat (easily beat Fistrick)
Enhanced strength for his size (carried a Revonnahgander in flight without trouble)
weaknesses: Small, physically unimposing body - everything depends on the mustache
No ranged, energy or defensive powers
summary: A pot-bellied, buck-toothed gentleman-mole in a green jumpsuit who fights, flies and lifts trucks with a huge living mustache.
traits: Speaks in a stereotypically posh British accent with high vocabulary (from Breakpoint onward)
Nicknamed 'Fuzzy-Wuzzy Alien Form' by Nighty Knight
Both Ben Prime and Ben 23 find him lamer than Nighty Knight
Design idea came from a crew member named Jerry
notableFeats: Flew Rook to safety and defeated Fistrick with mustache-fu (Breakpoint)
Defeated Yetta off-screen (No Honor Among Bros)
Flew with Nighty Knight to find Mad Rook (It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1)
Defeated a young Vilgax in 1773 with Skurd's help (A New Dawn)

notableEpisodes: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1
appearances.designNotes: Rodent-like alien in a green-and-black jumpsuit with his ears poking out, white gloves, big blond mustache, beaver-like teeth, slight potbelly; Omnitrix symbol on a green/white belt.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render (306x569, transparent); only official standing render available.

scoring.rationale: The mustache is a genuinely useful multi-tool - it lifts trucks, flies him and Rook, wraps foes and beat Fistrick and a young Vilgax - which earns mid mobility and modest strength. Everything else about him is small and ordinary with no ranged or defensive options.

notes: One of four aliens accidentally unlocked by Blukic and Driba in Outbreak; voiced by Yuri Lowenthal there, then David Kaye.
A New Dawn: 16-year-old Ben used Mole-Stache in 1773 (time travel) - still ben-16-ov. Store 23 use is a cameo among aliens shown to Ben 23.
Digging ability is comic-only (Super Secret Crisis War!) and non-canon. Albedo cannot use him. Appears in the Reboot VR game Omni-Charged (excluded).
